observation.visible_scene: A still landscape composition: a large snow-streaked mountain peak fills the upper background, a horizontal band of coniferous trees sits on the shoreline in the middle ground, and a calm lake occupies the lower half, mirroring the trees and sky. A soft sun glare with a faint hexagonal lens-flare circle glows on the left edge, and thin clouds/mist cling to the right shoulder and summit of the mountain. A small watermark logo is fixed in the bottom-left corner.
visible_changes: The overall framing (peak apex, tree line, shoreline) stays at the same pixel positions across all frames, indicating no camera pan, tilt, or zoom.

The dark vertical forms in the lower half are reflections of the trees, not separate objects; their shapes shimmer and wobble subtly from frame to frame, consistent with gentle ripples on the water surface.

The wispy clouds and the mist band along the mountain's right flank and top drift very slowly and change shape slightly over the excerpt, while the lower-left cloud puff over the ridge remains largely in place.
The left-side sun glare and lens-flare circle persist at roughly constant position and intensity throughout.
Tree trunks and canopies show no discernible swaying; the landforms and snow patches are static.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the cloud drift or water ripple continues, reverses, or intensifies beyond this 3.3 s window is not shown; the excerpt is a near-still scenic shot with no action onset or completion captured.
The cause of the glare (sun position) and any wind are not visible.
uncertain_details: The cloud/mist motion is extremely subtle and could partly be compression noise rather than clear translation.
Any movement of individual treetops is below the visible threshold, so 'trees are static' is a supported observation but not a proof of zero wind.
